_comment: Phase 293, migration 092 (K94, K119, K123, K131): columns added to manual_references (no live rows since Phase 117), which rewrites its SQL; two indexes on it; a new table manual_pages with a unique index; an external-content FTS5 index manual_pages_fts over it, with its four shadow tables and three triggers; a new table manual_reviewers; one schema_version row. The only rows added besides schema_version are the ones SQLite writes into two FTS5 shadow tables when the index is created (manual_pages_fts_config, which has no rowid and is read by its key, and manual_pages_fts_data), with the counts tests/test_phase293_migration.py measures on a fresh database. No existing row changes or is removed; every table not named here must not change at all.
